note: Status/title checks were performed during the planning run. This artifact records the external research sources used to shape module and item-quality benchmarks; it does not import copyrighted text into SlateCamp content.

sources.name: NBME Item Writing Guide

sources.use: Validity, reliability, fairness, documentation, and defensible assessment use.

sources.name: APA Standards landing page
sources.use: Companion source for the Standards book and testing-quality framing.

sources.name: University of Waterloo Centre for Teaching Excellence — Designing Multiple-Choice Questions

sources.name: Carnegie Mellon Eberly Center — Learning Objectives
sources.use: Constructive alignment: objectives, assessments, and instructional strategies must align.

sources.name: Quality Matters Higher Education Rubric Standards
sources.use: Course/module design alignment among objectives, assessment, instructional materials, activities, and technology.

sources.name: National Academies — How People Learn II
sources.use: Learning science: prior knowledge, practice, feedback, transfer, motivation, and context.

sources.name: Retrieval Practice strategies

sources.name: CAST Universal Design for Learning Guidelines
